about: A follow behind a walker on a forested trail in simulation (x500, planar lidar 12 m fixed to the frame, conifer crowns returning leaves at their bases near the 4 m flight height). One frame per scan from a second before the follow's start: the true attitude, height over the ground and position at the scan (local NE, m, from the run's start), the returns under 6 m as [bin, cm] (360 bins clockwise from the nose), and which returns under 3 m truly hit a trunk or a crown.
